brief:
Build an automation that I start by hand: manual trigger, no schedule, no file event.
1. nextcloud_list_files on folder "/Invoices-Q3".
2. nextcloud_read_file for each item of step 1 (forEach over its items, path = the item's path).
3. data_extraction for each result of step 2 on its content, with exactly these fields: datum (date), leverancier (string), factuurnummer (string), excl_btw (number), btw (number), totaal (number).
4. datatable add_row for each result of step 3 into the EXISTING datatable "Facturen" (id tbl_x, key facturen). Map the fields by column key and set status to the literal "open".
Do not create a table or columns. Dates as 2026-09-19; amounts as plain numbers with a dot (1554.25). Keep file order. Title "Facturen inlezen".
